# EXTEND.md Preferences Schema

## File Location

Check in order; first hit wins:

| Path | Scope |
|------|-------|
| `.baoyu-skills/baoyu-xhs-html/EXTEND.md` | Project |
| `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/baoyu-skills/baoyu-xhs-html/EXTEND.md` | XDG |
| `$HOME/.baoyu-skills/baoyu-xhs-html/EXTEND.md` | User home |

## Schema

```yaml
# baoyu-xhs-html preferences
# Generated by first-time setup or manual editing

## Watermark
watermark:
  enabled: false              # boolean
  content: ""                 # string, e.g. "@your_handle"
  position: "bottom-right"    # top-left | top-right | bottom-left | bottom-right

## Style Defaults
preferred_style: "auto"       # auto | cute | fresh | warm | bold | minimal | retro |
                              # pop | notion | chalkboard | study-notes |
                              # screen-print | sketch-notes

preferred_layout: "auto"      # auto | sparse | balanced | dense | list | comparison |
                              # flow | mindmap | quadrant

preferred_palette: "auto"     # auto | macaron | warm | neon | default

preferred_aspect: "3:4"       # 3:4 | 1:1 | 4:3 | 9:16

## Language
language: "auto"              # auto | zh | en | ja | ko | ...

## Content
default_card_count: 5         # integer, 2-10

## Custom Styles (optional)
# custom_styles:
#   - name: my-style
#     extends: notion         # base style to extend
#     overrides:
#       font: "Noto Serif SC"
#       background: "#FFFAF0"
#       accent: "#FF6347"
```

## Field Details

### watermark

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `enabled` | boolean | `false` | Show watermark on all cards |
| `content` | string | `""` | Watermark text content |
| `position` | string | `"bottom-right"` | Position on the card |

Positions:
- `top-left`: Top-left corner
- `top-right`: Top-right corner
- `bottom-left`: Bottom-left corner
- `bottom-right`: Bottom-right corner (default)

### preferred_style

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `auto` | Auto-select based on content analysis (default) |
| `cute` | Always use cute style |
| `fresh` | Always use fresh style |
| `warm` | Always use warm style |
| `bold` | Always use bold style |
| `minimal` | Always use minimal style |
| `retro` | Always use retro style |
| `pop` | Always use pop style |
| `notion` | Always use notion style |
| `chalkboard` | Always use chalkboard style |
| `study-notes` | Always use study-notes style |
| `screen-print` | Always use screen-print style |
| `sketch-notes` | Always use sketch-notes style |

### preferred_layout

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `auto` | Auto-select based on content (default) |
| `sparse` | 1-2 points, maximum impact |
| `balanced` | 3-4 points, standard |
| `dense` | 5-8 points, knowledge-card |
| `list` | Enumeration / ranking |
| `comparison` | Side-by-side contrast |
| `flow` | Process / timeline |
| `mindmap` | Center-radial |
| `quadrant` | Four-quadrant |

### preferred_palette

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `auto` | Use style's built-in palette (default) |
| `default` | Same as auto |
| `macaron` | Override with macaron palette |
| `warm` | Override with warm palette |
| `neon` | Override with neon palette |

### preferred_aspect

| Value | Dimensions | Best For |
|-------|-----------|----------|
| `3:4` | 1080×1440 | Xiaohongshu, WeChat (default) |
| `1:1` | 1080×1080 | Instagram |
| `4:3` | 1440×1080 | Presentation |
| `9:16` | 1080×1920 | Story, vertical video |

### language

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `auto` | Detect from source content (default) |
| `zh` | Chinese |
| `en` | English |
| `ja` | Japanese |
| `ko` | Korean |

### default_card_count

- Type: integer
- Range: 2-10
- Default: 5
- Can be overridden per invocation via `--count N` or Path B customization.

## Example EXTEND.md

```yaml
watermark:
  enabled: true
  content: "@my_handle"
  position: "bottom-right"

preferred_style: notion
preferred_layout: dense
preferred_palette: macaron
preferred_aspect: "3:4"

language: zh
default_card_count: 5
```
